High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore

sentences.text:
Appearance:
 Shri Akash Rathi - Advocate for the applicant.
 Shri Virendra Khadav - G.A. appearing on behalf of Ad
 General.
Perused the case diary / challan papers.

2. This is fourth bail application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (439 of Cr.P.C.) as he/she is implicated in connection with Crime No.142/2022 registered at Police Station Gandhwani, District Dhar (MP) for offence punishable under Section 420, 467, 468, 471, 120-B and 201 of IPC.
The applicant is in custody since 22/03/2022.

3. His earlier bail applications have already been dismissed by this Court on merits and his Special Leave Petition (Crl.) No.8225/2024 has also been dismissed by the Supreme Court on 23/08/2024 with a further direction to the trial Court to conclude the trial preferably within a period of six months.

From the status report dated 24/05/2024, sent by the trial Court, it has been informed that the matter is at its fag end as the accused statements are to be recorded on 31/05/2025 and the matter Bhangda @ Bhagat vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 8 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/137133496/
1 shall be concluded at the earliest, however, counsel for the applicant had informed this Court on 28/07/2025 that co-accused Deepak has been arrested subsequently and the learned Judge of the trial Court has observed that the case of the applicant shall be kept in abeyance till the evidence is led in the case of the co-accused Deepak.

entities.text: Bhangda @ Bhagat vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 8 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
5. Be that as it may, taking into account the status report sent by the trial Court on 24/05/2025, the present application is disposed of with a direction to the learned Judge of the trial Court to try the co-accused Deepak separately, and if the trial of the present applicant and the other accused persons whose statements were to be recorded on 31/05/2025 is at the fag end, the final order shall be passed in the aforesaid trial, without waiting for further evidence, which is to be led in the case of co-accused Deepak.
6. Let the aforesaid exercise be completed as expeditiously as possible within the time as mentioned in the status report.
7. Accordingly, M.Cr.C. stands disposed of.
(SUBODH ABHYANKAR) JUDGE krjoshi Bhangda @ Bhagat vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 8 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/137133496/
